audience: admins and team leads who run their business phone system in Spoke Phone

useCases.title: Review yesterday's calls
useCases.text: The AI lists calls from a time window with caller, direction, duration and the assigned user or team. You see who handled what and which calls went unanswered.

useCases.title: Read a call's transcript and AI summary
useCases.text: The AI finds the call and its transcript, reads both, adds the stored AI content analysis, and sums up what was said and agreed.

useCases.title: Check who is available right now
useCases.text: The AI reads the directory and the users with their live availability, so you can see who can take a call and which team they belong to.

useCases.title: See how locations and teams are staffed
useCases.text: The AI lists the locations and the users assigned to each one, together with the teams, to give an overview of your setup.

useCases.title: Keep caller ID contacts up to date
useCases.text: Give a name and number. The AI saves the contact in a shared phonebook so it shows in caller ID, or removes one that is out of date.

useCases.title: Send a text message after a call
useCases.text: After you confirm the recipient and the wording, the AI sends an SMS from a company number. The message shows in the Spoke conversation.
